dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, following a smooth convex-to-straight geometric profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None visible; the lateral margins where the skin meets the water appear smooth and symmetrical without localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface, consistent throughout the visible area and several tones darker than mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Highly diffuse; there are no sharp gradient slopes or defined edges between pigmented and depigmented zones.

other_distinctive_markers: Centrally located, high-contrast dark circular blowhole on the anterior dorsal surface; a distinct longitudinal dorsal ridge is visible as a high-reflectance line along the posterior midline.
